name: pdrforge
description: CRM для PDR и кузовных мастерских

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @pdrforge/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @pdrforge/api" "npm run dev -w @pdrforge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pdrforge/shared && npm run build -w @pdrforge/api && npm run build -w @pdrforge/web
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @pdrforge/shared && npm run seed -w @pdrforge/api
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
